entries.description_en: The first time you gain Block from a card each combat, double the amount gained.

entries.name: 天鹅绒颈圈
entries.description: 在每回合开始时获得[energy:1]。你每回合不能打出超过6张牌。
entries.description_en: Gain [energy:1] at the start of each turn. You cannot play more than 6 cards per turn.

entries.name: 古茶具套装
entries.description: 到达休息处后的下一场战斗开始时额外获得[energy:2]。
entries.description_en: Whenever you enter a Rest Site, start the next combat with an additional [energy:2].

entries.name: 烫嘴可可
entries.description: 在每场战斗的第一回合额外获得[energy:4]。
entries.description_en: Start each combat with an additional [energy:4].

entries.name: 烦人机关盒
entries.description: 在每场战斗开始时，将一张随机卡牌加入你的手牌。这张牌在本回合可以免费打出。
entries.description_en: At the start of each combat, add a random card into your Hand. It's free to play this turn.

entries.name: 维特鲁威仆从
entries.description: 名字中有“仆从”的卡牌造成双倍的伤害与格挡。
entries.description_en: Cards containing “Minion” deal double damage and gain double Block.

entries.name: 战锤
entries.description: 每当你击败一名精英敌人的时候，随机升级4张牌。
entries.description_en: Whenever you kill an Elite, Upgrade 4 random cards.

entries.name: 战纹涂料
entries.description: 拾起时，随机升级2张技能牌。
entries.description_en: Upon pickup, Upgrade 2 random Skills.

entries.name: 磨刀石
entries.description: 拾起时，随机升级2张攻击牌。
entries.description_en: Upon pickup, Upgrade 2 random Attacks.

entries.name: 低语耳环
entries.description: 在每个回合开始时，获得[energy:1]。瓦库将接管你的第一回合。
entries.description_en: Gain [energy:1] at the start of each turn. Vakuu plays your first turn for you.

entries.name: 白兽雕像
entries.description: 战斗结束后必定掉落药水。
entries.description_en: Potions always appear in combat rewards.

entries.name: 白星
entries.description: 精英敌人额外掉落一次稀有卡牌奖励。
entries.description_en: Elites drop an additional Rare card reward.

entries.name: 羽翼之靴
entries.description: 你在选择下一层的房间时有3次机会可以无视当前的路线。
entries.description_en: You may ignore paths when choosing the next rooms to travel to 3 times.

entries.name: 羽翼护符
entries.description: 每次卡牌奖励中，都会有随机一张牌被附魔：迅捷1。
